title: SQL Injection in User Lookup
summary: Replaced raw string concatenation with parameterized SQL placeholder.
patch:
diff --git a/pkg/auth/store.go b/pkg/auth/store.go
index 4444444..5555555 100644
--- a/pkg/auth/store.go
+++ b/pkg/auth/store.go
@@ -42,1 +42,1 @@
-	query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, name, role FROM users WHERE id = '%s'", id)
+	query := "SELECT id, name, role FROM users WHERE id = $1"

hunks.original: query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, name, role FROM users WHERE id = '%s'", id)
hunks.replacement: query := "SELECT id, name, role FROM users WHERE id = $1"
